messages:
nora: opened PR 9155 to add a small Console guide for the new cost-per-model widget + trace propagation examples in Swift and PHP. also fixed a stale anchor in dashboards and noted a YAML key rename that needs a migration blurb.

ivan: nice. which YAML key changed? i'll sweep links/anchors once you post the snippets.

nora: the rename is modelId -> model_id in our dashboard embed YAML. metadata: we want to surface model-level cost rows; older embeds used camelCase. plan is to show both keys in a compat box and add a deprecation note.

sloane: paste the snippets so i can run them in the examples runner.

nora: Swift first:
```swift
// Swift (redwood-ios >=0.3)
import Redwood
let client = RedwoodClient(apiKey: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REDWOOD_KEY"]!)
try await client.attachTrace(traceId: "tr-555", attrs: ["route":"/v1/generate", "model":"r-s"], cost: ["tokens": 8])
// subsequent generate call can reuse the current trace context
```

nora: PHP snippet:
```php
// PHP (redwood-php >=0.1)
require 'vendor/autoload.php';
$client = new \Redwood\Client(getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'));
$client->attach_trace(['trace_id' => 'tr-555', 'attrs' => ['route' => '/v1/generate', 'model' => 'r-s'], 'cost' => ['tokens' => 8]]);
// follow-up $client->generate(..., ['trace_context' => $client->current_trace()]);
```

rahul: quick nit: mention SDK versions above snippets (Swift v0.3+, PHP v0.1+). also the Swift async snippet uses attachTrace naming; add a small note that some older iOS SDKs used camelCase attachTrace vs attach_trace compatibility shim.

nora: good call 1 i'll add a short "SDK compatibility" callout above the code blocks.

docs-bot: link-checker: replaced /docs/dashboards#old-widget-anchor -> /docs/dashboards#cost-per-model. please verify anchor exists.

ivan: confirmed the new anchor exists. for the YAML migration, suggest showing a compact example: 
```yaml
# canonical
model_id: "r-s"
# legacy (accepted, deprecated)
modelId: "r-s"
```

sloane: ran the snippets: PHP needed the fully-qualified namespace in the example (\Redwood\Client) which nora already used, good. Swift compiled with the client stub locally after adding the concurrency context in the runner. I also uploaded the new widget screenshot and added alt text: "Cost-per-model widget showing tokens and aggregated GPU-ms per model".

rahul: can we add a tiny docs-ci job that parses the example YAML file and checks for camelCase fields? non-blocking for initial merge, but useful to have as a follow-up.

nora: i'll file a follow-up PR to add the yaml-parse job. for this PR i'll include a CI note in the description referencing the follow-up.

ivan: one more: add a short migration FAQ Q/A: "Do embedded dashboards break?" -> "No immediate break, the server accepts legacy keys but emits deprecation logs; update embeds to snake_case to avoid future issues and to ensure the widget picks up model-level rows."

nora: adding that and squashing commits. assigning reviewers: ivan, sloane, rahul. targeting merge after CI. thanks all!

docs-bot: ci: link-check passed; awaiting examples-runner and yaml-parse follow-up.
